svg.text: NovaTech Systems Ltd. | March 2026 | 10 Controls · 4 Priority Tiers · Implementation Roadmap
| Root cause: MFA gap · Weak creds · No email sandbox · Excessive privileges · Flat LAN
Enforce MFA on VPN & All Remote Access
Deploy Azure AD MFA + FIDO2/TOTP; conditional access
policy requiring MFA for all off-network authentication
Enable Microsoft Defender ATP or Proofpoint sandbox;
detonate all executable & macro-enabled attachments before delivery
Configure CrowdStrike to auto-update every 4 hours;
alert SOC if any endpoint signature is >24h behind
Audit all service accounts; remove domain admin rights;
implement least-privilege; replace shared service accounts with per-app accounts
Deploy workstation VLAN isolation; workstations cannot reach
each other directly; all inter-segment routing via firewall ACLs
Deploy SSL inspection at proxy for all outbound HTTPS;
enables content-aware DLP to detect exfiltration, not just volume
Enable UEBA in SIEM; alert on logins from new countries,
impossible travel, off-hours access, and bulk data access patterns
Integrate HaveIBeenPwned Enterprise API; alert security team
when employee credentials appear in breach databases; force reset
Quarterly phishing simulations for all staff; mandatory training
for employees who fail; track click rates over time
Incident Response Plan Review & Tabletop Exercises
Review and update IRP every 6 months; conduct annual tabletop
exercise simulating ransomware and exfiltration scenarios
Response time could be improved further
Post-Incident Preventive Action Plan · INC-2026-0312 · NovaTech Systems Ltd. · March 2026 · CONFIDENTIAL — Security Operations Center
